headlines.text: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says. Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the overnight barrage, in which two people died.
Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy. The singer spoke about Israel and Gaza after Macklemore was dropped from his tour for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.
German elections under way which could decide fate of Chancellor Merz. The chancellor is facing intense political pressure which will increase if his party struggles in Sunday's polls.
Trump says his planned triumphal arch will double as a military complex to store ammunition. Trump said the updated plans were at the request of the US military and for national security purposes.

Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles. A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.
Our head teacher was an abuser. We joined forces to get justice - now we're married. Students spent years collecting evidence against their Indonesian principal, before falling in love.

Cultural treasures are being destroyed worldwide - so why is no-one being punished?. A cauldron of conflicts is bubbling across the world, with cultural monuments being destroyed. These people are fighting against it.
Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'. Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.
Journalists denied White House access after Trump banned some media outlets. CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters' White House press badges were confiscated, the outlets reported.
Converse pulls 'deeply upsetting' advert after backlash. Social media users say an image from the brand's Instagram account resembled a KKK hood and hanging.
Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test. The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC.
Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa. Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.

Trump says US will form 'AI Force' and appoint an artificial intelligence tsar. The president said his administration "will not in any way hinder or stifle the growth" amid amid warnings about the emergent technology.
Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill. The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

Shark attack prompts rare kill order in Western Australia as victim named. Greg O'Neill "loved the ocean", his family say, as police boats and helicopters patrol Perth's beaches in search of his body and the shark that attacked him.
DR Congo rolls out Ebola vaccine for health workers as death toll rises. 50,000 frontline staff to receive a jab for a different Ebola strain, with 20,000 enrolled in a one-year clinical trial.
Iran war live: Tehran sets terms for peace; Saudi forces foil Riyadh attack. Iran security chief says Tehran's demands include an end to war on all fronts and the lifting of US's naval blockade.
Turkiye backs Saudi Arabia’s security amid escalating Houthi attacks: FM. Turkish FM highlights Turkiye's readiness to assist Saudi Arabia militarily, as Houthi attacks intensify in Yemen.
Saudi-led coalition says defences intercept Houthi missile fired at Riyadh. It was the first air raid alert in Riyadh since an escalation in fighting between the Houthis in Yemen and Saudi Arabia.
Fulham vs Manchester United: Premier League – prediction, teams, lineups. Man United have won only one league game this season, putting Michael Carrick under pressure ahead of Fulham trip.
Israel’s president pardons soldier who killed wounded Palestinian in 2016. Elor Azaria had shot a Palestinian who had already been incapacitated by Israeli troops, in controversial case.
Lacking equipment, but not ambition: Gaza students try to keep up with tech. Gaza's IT industry has been devastated from three-years of bombing and destruction.
Hegseth kicks off ‘Send Me Tour’ amid Iran war backlash. US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth has kicked off his ‘Send Me Tour’ in Texas amid Iran war backlash.
Denmark says ‘binding’ US deal on Greenland won’t compromise sovereignty. Trump has wanted a foothold in Greenland for some time, as a strategic battle unfolds for supremacy in warming Arctic.
Canadians warm to EU ‘associate membership’ proposal. From work and study to trade, Canadians see new possibilities in closer ties with the European Union.
Trump says he will create ‘AI Force’ with new ‘AI czar’. The announcements come as AI faces mounting concerns from populations across the United States.
Iran says conditions to re-engage in talks, end war sent to US via Qatar. Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, tells Al Jazeera Tehran awaiting Trump response.
Israel targets paramedics in southern Lebanon. Two back-to-back Israeli air strikes hit Nabatieh in Lebanon, while a third strike targeted an ambulance team.
Cuba works to restore power after another major nationwide blackout. The outage marks at least the sixth one this year after a United States-imposed energy blockade went into effect.
Dutch riot police break up violent far-right protest in The Hague. Justice minister condemns 'Hitler salutes, antisemitic slogans, violence' at the anti-immigration rally.

Arch Manning throws 2 TD passes as top-ranked Texas holds off UTSA with SEC schedule looming. Arch Manning connected with Cam Coleman for two early touchdowns, but the Texas Longhorns quarterback struggled through much of the 30-6 win over UTSA.

US military strikes alleged narco-trafficking vessel in Caribbean, killing 4 'narco-terrorists'. Video shows a Caribbean vessel erupting into a fireball as SOUTHCOM says it killed four alleged narco-terrorists in a drug trafficking strike.

Notre Dame football holds Michigan State to 167 total yards in 27-10 home victory. CJ Carr threw for 234 yards as No. 3 Notre Dame's defense forced two turnovers and held Michigan State to just 167 total yards in the rout.

Justice Department charges 16 across multiple states with alleged illegal voting, election crimes. The Department of Justice charged 16 people across multiple states for alleged illegal voting, with eight noncitizens in Texas among those accused.

READ IT: Ed Sheeran's pre-concert speech to Philly crowd about the Gaza controversy. Ed Sheeran called the Gaza devastation "catastrophic and unjustifiable" in a rare political speech before his Philadelphia concert Saturday night.

'Devoted' father and grandfather-to-be swimming at popular beach killed in suspected fatal shark attack. Greg O'Neill, 63, was attacked by a great white shark at Sorrento Beach in Perth, Western Australia, prompting a rare catch-and-kill order.

Kentucky shocks ninth-ranked Texas A&M behind dominant defense in SEC upset. CJ Baxter and Kenny Minchey powered Kentucky's stunning 31-21 upset of No. 9 Texas A&M, fueled by a third quarter that outgained the Aggies 196-20.

Search underway for suspected gunman outside Notre Dame football game vs Michigan State. Police launched a search near Eddy Street Commons for a suspected gunman as Notre Dame's football game against Michigan State was still underway.

Three Cowboys players fined more than $33,000 combined after season-opening loss to Giants. Three Dallas Cowboys players owe a combined $33,409 in NFL fines after a late hit, facemask and taunting call marred their loss to the Giants.

Engelbert Humperdinck reveals how an untied shoelace saved his life during British Army service. Engelbert Humperdinck revealed on his podcast how an untied shoelace during British Army training kept him from a deadly assignment in Cyprus.

Vanderbilt pulled off the most improbable last-second victory you'll ever see in college football. Vanderbilt's miracle finish against NC State featured a stunning fumble recovery with one second left after CJ Bailey's critical mistake at the goal line.

Melanie Griffith stuns in black swimsuit during wellness retreat: 'Healing and renewal'. Melanie Griffith shared stunning swimsuit photos from her week at Austrian health resort, calling the experience "a little heaven on earth."

Flight attendants reveal 90-second 'hotel room autopsy' that could save your life. Flight attendants reveal their six-step "hotel room autopsy" routine that others can learn from, including scanning for intruders and checking door locks and emergency exits.

New Jersey mom charged with obstruction after 'missing' son found hiding in her crawl space. A New Jersey mother reportedly told East Brunswick police her missing teen wasn't home, but officers found the juvenile hiding in a crawl space in her basement.

ESPN reporter claims she 'made it out alive' after vintage Bill Belichick sideline interview. Bill Belichick's trademark sideline interview snark followed him to the Tar Heels, leaving reporter Stormy Buonantony with a 20-second exchange.

Saudi Arabia says Houthis tried to attack its capital. Saudi Arabia on Saturday said that Yemen's Houthi rebels tried to attack Riyadh with a ballistic missile, the first time the Saudi capital has been targeted since the escalation in fighting with the Iran-backed rebels opened a new front in the Iran war.

Ed Sheeran says situation in Gaza is 'catastrophic and unjustifiable' as he opens solo concert. Ed Sheeran opened a solo concert Saturday with comments about Gaza after controversy swirled around his tour and supporting acts withdrew in solidarity with opener Macklemore, who was dropped after making pro-Palestinian comments onstage.

The new lines of southern Lebanon. The U.N. expanded the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon's mandate 20 years ago to include monitoring adherence to a ceasefire in fighting between Israel and Lebanon's Iran-backed Hezbollah — the militant group created in 1982 to counter a second Israeli invasion.

CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban. Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."

Opinion: Remembering Annie Dillard, nature writer. With her 1974 book, "Pilgrim at Tinker Creek," Annie Dillard became the youngest woman to win the Pulitzer Prize. We take a moment to remember her and her work.
Life in Kabul 5 years after the Taliban's return. Five years after the return of Taliban rule, NPR visited Kabul to see how Afghans are dealing with their new government's strict social restrictions.

Betel nuts are a top mind-affecting substance. Now there's evidence of ancient use. New research on ancient human remains suggests the habitual usage of betel nuts, a plant seed with mind-affecting properties that is popular in parts of Asia despite the health risks it presents.

Archaeologists are racing to save precious artifacts in Alaska after last year's storm. Last year, remnants of a typhoon damaged homes, infrastructure and an archaeological dig site. Now, archaeologists are trying to get as many objects out as possible before the next storm.

Ever wonder how the Fed's interest rate actually works? We've got answers. The Federal Reserve just raised interest rates this week for the first time this year. So how does it actually work? And what does it mean for the economy — and the rest of us? Here are some answers.

Russia holds parliamentary vote in areas it seized from Ukraine in the war. Russia's parliamentary election for the first time is being held in Ukraine's regions that Moscow illegally annexed after the start of its full-scale invasion more than 4 1/2 years ago.
